steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. Each covenant test uses its definition and must leave headroom above the warning level.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 covenant test does not follow from its figures

findings.title: Test value does not follow from the figures
findings.fix: Recompute the test from the definition

findings.title: Headroom under the warning level
findings.fix: Warn the lender early and plan the action

findings.title: Figures not from the definition
findings.fix: Use the definition in the agreement

outcome.notChecked: Whether the agreement's definitions are what the lender will apply; any waiver.

pros: Checks a covenant whose figures are not from the definition, a test value that does not follow from the figures, and a headroom under the stated warning level.
cons: Not checked: Whether the agreement's definitions are what the lender will apply; any waiver.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-fin-covenant-check skill on the records for this review.
